 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Split at the unique solid divider; return the shared color of the two regions.
    div_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r in range(h))), None)
    if div_col is not None:
        a = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(div_col)}
        b = {grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(div_col + 1, w)}
        common = a & b
        color = next(iter(common)) if len(common) == 1 else 0
        return [[color for _ in range(min(div_col, w-div_col-1))] for _ in range(h)]
    # Horizontal divider case: the shared color across the regions is the output fill.
    div_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    if div_row is not None:
        a = {x for row in grid[:div_row] for x in row}
        b = {x for row in grid[div_row+1:] for x in row}
        color = next(iter(a & b))
        n = len(grid[0])
        return [[color for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    return grid

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*14 for _ in range(14)]
    demo[4][6] = 8
    # Demonstration task output is 14x14 filled with 8.
    assert transform(demo) == [[8]*14 for _ in range(14)]
    test = [[2,7,2,7,2,2,2,7,2,2,0,9,9,9,7,9,9,7,7,7,9]]
    print(transform(test))
",
 "cross_profile": false
}
